dict.string: Co-Driver uses the microphone to hear your voice commands so it can assist you hands-free while driving.
Co-Driver uses speech recognition to convert your voice to text so the AI can respond to your questions and commands.
Co-Driver uses your location to find nearby fuel stops, rest areas, and to provide accurate weather and routing information.
Co-Driver reads heart rate, HRV, and sleep data to calculate a fatigue score and help keep you safe on the road.
Co-Driver may write health data to Apple Health as part of fatigue monitoring and driver wellness tracking.
